Name: Power Unit
Description: Provides initial enegry to Behemoth powered by fusion core. Aside from energy, can be used to power the engine for slow movement.

Name: Capsule Launcher
Description: A 360 degree gun that allows shooting extraction capsules on islands. Also allows capsule production.

Name: R&D Lab
Description: Allows research of building blueprints based on collectible blueprint parts

Name: Sensor system
Description: Provides information about surroundings: islands, resources, POIs, events etc. as well as territory control radius

Name: Engine
Description: Powers the Behemoth's movement based on fuel cells, energy generators, and other types of power
